main.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
main.summary: Peter Jackson's The Fellowship of the Ring opened the film trilogy in 2001.

cards.heading: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
cards.text: Peter Jackson's The Fellowship of the Ring opened the film trilogy in 2001. Adapted from Tolkien by Jackson, Fran Walsh and Philippa Boyens, it follows Frodo Baggins after the One Ring comes into his possession. Sauron seeks its power, and the only way to destroy it is to reach Mount Doom in Mordor. Eight companions join Frodo as the Fellowship. Their departure gives the large conflict a travelling group's perspective, with Elijah Wood as Frodo and Ian McKellen as Gandalf among an ensemble bringing Middle-earth's peoples and loyalties to the screen.

main.title: Wikipedia
main.summary: Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia written and maintained by a community of volunteer editors, known as Wikipedians, through open collaboration and the wiki software MediaWiki.

cards.heading: Wikipedia
cards.text:
Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia written and maintained by a community of volunteer editors, known as Wikipedians, through open collaboration and the wiki software MediaWiki. Founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger in 2001, Wikipedia has been hosted since 2003 by the Wikimedia Foundation, an American nonprofit organization funded mainly by donations from readers. Wikipedia is the largest and most read reference work in history.

Initially available only in English, Wikipedia has grown to over 300 languages and is one of the world's most visited websites as of 2026. The English Wikipedia, with over 7 million articles, remains the largest of the editions, which together comprise more than 68 million articles and attract more than 1.5 billion unique device visits and 13 million edits per month (about five edits per second on average)  as of April 2024. As of December 2025, over 25% of Wikipedia's traffic comes from the United States, while Japan accounts for nearly 7%, and the United Kingdom, Germany, and Russia each represent around 5%.

main.title: Amélie
main.subtitle: Small interventions in the lives of Montmartre
main.summary: Jean-Pierre Jeunet's Amélie follows a young waitress in Montmartre who begins arranging small surprises for the people around her. Audrey Tautou plays Amélie Poulain, whose lively imagination sits alongside a reluctance to expose her own feelings. The film opened in France on 25 April 2001, combining a romantic comedy with a carefully constructed portrait of everyday pleasures.

cards.heading: An imaginative waitress
cards.text: Jean-Pierre Jeunet's Amélie follows a young waitress in Montmartre who begins arranging small surprises for the people around her. Audrey Tautou plays Amélie Poulain, whose lively imagination sits alongside a reluctance to expose her own feelings. The film opened in France on 25 April 2001, combining a romantic comedy with a carefully constructed portrait of everyday pleasures.

cards.heading: A collection of small missions
cards.text: A hidden box of childhood keepsakes gives Amélie her first mission: returning it to its former owner without revealing herself. His response encourages further interventions in the neighbourhood. Jeunet gives these schemes the precision of little mechanisms, using objects, notes and carefully timed encounters to set them in motion. When Amélie becomes interested in Nino, who collects discarded photo-booth pictures, her talent for arranging other people's happiness becomes less useful. She must risk taking part herself.

cards.heading: The details of a neighbourhood
cards.text: The film's Paris is shaped by strong reds and greens, detailed interiors and sudden flights of imagination. Lists of private likes and dislikes make even minor characters specific, while Yann Tiersen's music helps connect their separate routines. This attention to small habits gives the romance much of its charm. At the 2002 Césars, the film won best film and director, with further awards for Tiersen's original music and Aline Bonetto's production design.

main.title: Tokyo DisneySea opens
main.subtitle: A second park built around the sea
main.summary: Tokyo DisneySea opened on 4 September 2001 as a separate, sea-themed park beside Tokyo Disneyland.

cards.heading: A second park built around the sea
cards.text: Tokyo DisneySea opened at 8 a.m. on September 4, 2001, with an inauguration at Mediterranean Harbor. Oriental Land and Disney built the second park around maritime journeys and imagined ports. Plans for another park dated to 1988; the sea-based concept emerged in 1992, and the DisneySea name was presented in 1997. Discussions between the Japanese and American partners produced the entrance AquaSphere, representing Earth as a water planet. The opening brought a second distinct park to the resort beside Tokyo Disneyland.

main.title: September 11 attacks
main.summary: The September 11 attacks, colloquially known as 9/11, were a coordinated series of suicide attacks perpetrated by the Islamic terrorist organization al-Qaeda against the United States in 2001.

cards.heading: September 11 attacks
cards.text:
The September 11 attacks, colloquially known as 9/11, were a coordinated series of suicide attacks perpetrated by the Islamic terrorist organization al-Qaeda against the United States in 2001. A total of 19 hijackers commandeered four commercial passenger airliners. The first two planes were flown into each of the Twin Towers at the World Trade Center in New York City, while the third plane crashed into the Pentagon, the headquarters of the United States Department of Defense, in Arlington County, Virginia. The fourth plane crashed in a rural field in Pennsylvania during a passenger revolt.

The attacks killed 2,977 people, injured thousands more, and gave rise to long-term health consequences while causing at least US$10 billion in infrastructure and property damage.

main.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
main.subtitle: Chris Columbus brings Hogwarts to the cinema
main.summary: A letter gives Harry Potter a life beyond the home of the relatives who have raised him. On his way to Hogwarts, he discovers a hidden shopping street, a train platform and a school where magic is part of the daily timetable. Chris Columbus's adaptation casts Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint and Emma Watson as Harry, Ron and Hermione, following their friendship into the mystery surrounding a protected object inside the castle. The film opened in Britain and the United States on 16 November 2001, after its London premiere on 4 November.

cards.heading: The letter arrives

cards.heading: Building a school to return to
cards.text: The first film established places that the series could repeatedly revisit. The Great Hall was built in 2000, giving the young cast a physical space for feasts, lessons and ceremonies; its enchanted ceiling was completed through visual effects. The journey from the Dursleys' house into that larger world is also carried by John Williams's music, particularly Hedwig's Theme. Steve Kloves adapted Rowling's novel for the screen, retaining the school-year progression as the characters move from arrival and discovery towards a test of what each friend can contribute.

main.title: The Wire
main.subtitle: A Baltimore investigation opens onto the institutions around it
main.summary: David Simon's The Wire begins with police trying to understand a drug organisation in Baltimore. Premiering on HBO in the United States on 2 June 2002, the series follows investigators and the people they pursue inside the same city. Its attention gradually reaches docks, local government, schools and a newspaper, placing the original investigation within a wider network of institutions.

cards.heading: An investigation inside a city
cards.text: David Simon's The Wire begins with police trying to understand a drug organisation in Baltimore. Premiering on HBO in the United States on 2 June 2002, the series follows investigators and the people they pursue inside the same city. Its attention gradually reaches docks, local government, schools and a newspaper, placing the original investigation within a wider network of institutions.

cards.heading: The pressure for results
cards.text: Much of the police work depends on patient observation and learning how people communicate. A useful case may require time that senior officers do not want to give it, while demands for immediate results change what is counted as success. Similar pressures operate on the streets, where individuals work within hierarchies and routines of their own. The parallel makes decisions understandable without making the consequences equivalent or removing responsibility from the people involved.

cards.heading: Connections across five seasons
cards.text: Across five seasons, the ensemble carries experience from one institution into another. A reform can solve an immediate problem while exposing a limit elsewhere, and personal competence does not guarantee lasting influence. Simon's background in Baltimore reporting gives the series a dense vocabulary of work and place. The continuing structure rewards attention to minor encounters: a conversation or administrative decision can acquire its full significance only after its effects have reached other parts of the city.

main.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
main.subtitle: A hidden chamber turns Hogwarts into a place of suspicion
main.summary: Harry returns to Hogwarts after Dobby, a house-elf, tries to prevent him from going back. Soon students are found petrified and the school begins to fear that a hidden chamber has been opened. Chris Columbus again directs Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint and Emma Watson, with Kenneth Branagh joining as the boastful Gilderoy Lockhart and Jason Isaacs as Lucius Malfoy. Released in Britain and the United States on 15 November 2002, the second film follows Harry's attempts to understand the attacks while suspicion increasingly falls on him.

cards.heading: Warnings and whispers
cards.text: Harry returns to Hogwarts after Dobby, a house-elf, tries to prevent him from going back. Soon students are found petrified and the school begins to fear that a hidden chamber has been opened. Chris Columbus again directs Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint and Emma Watson, with Kenneth Branagh joining as the boastful Gilderoy Lockhart and Jason Isaacs as Lucius Malfoy. Released in Britain and the United States on 15 November 2002, the second film follows Harry's attempts to understand the attacks while suspicion increasingly falls on him.

cards.heading: The danger inside Hogwarts
cards.text: The familiar classrooms and corridors become places to search for clues. A diary allows Harry to enter another person's account of the past, while the Forbidden Forest leads him towards a much larger creature and another version of events. For this film the forest was recreated entirely in the studio to accommodate Aragog's lair, expanding a setting introduced through location and studio work in the first instalment. John Williams's score adds new musical identities, including Fawkes the Phoenix, alongside themes that already connect the audience to Hogwarts.

main.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
main.subtitle: Peter Jackson follows the broken Fellowship across Middle-earth
main.summary: The Two Towers opened in American cinemas on 18 December 2002, continuing Peter Jackson's adaptation of J. R. R. Tolkien. With the Fellowship divided, the film follows several journeys at once. Frodo and Sam accept Gollum as their guide towards Mordor; Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli become involved in the defence of Rohan; Merry and Pippin encounter Treebeard and the Ents. Cutting between these groups lets the growing war and the smaller, increasingly difficult journey of the Ring develop together.

cards.heading: The Fellowship separates
cards.text: The Two Towers opened in American cinemas on 18 December 2002, continuing Peter Jackson's adaptation of J. R. R. Tolkien. With the Fellowship divided, the film follows several journeys at once. Frodo and Sam accept Gollum as their guide towards Mordor; Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli become involved in the defence of Rohan; Merry and Pippin encounter Treebeard and the Ents. Cutting between these groups lets the growing war and the smaller, increasingly difficult journey of the Ring develop together.

cards.heading: Gollum becomes a character
cards.text: Gollum gives that journey an unstable companion. Andy Serkis supplied the performance on which the digital character was built, and Weta Digital developed its animation and rendering techniques to carry his expressions and movements onto the screen. His arguments with himself make the struggle over the Ring visible within a single character. Frodo sees someone damaged by a burden he now shares, while Sam distrusts the guide on whom their route increasingly depends.

cards.heading: A siege in the rain
cards.text: At Helm's Deep, the film brings the defence of Rohan into a prolonged night battle. Rain, ladders, walls and a breached gate give the siege a clear physical shape even as the armies grow. Weta's work combined the large battle with digital characters across hundreds of effects shots and won the Academy Award for Visual Effects. Howard Shore's score gives Rohan its own musical identity, including the fiddle heard in The Riders of Rohan, alongside themes carried forward from the first film.

main.title: Human Genome Project
main.summary: The Human Genome Project was declared complete on April 14, 2003, after an international effort to map and sequence human DNA.

cards.heading: Human Genome Project
cards.text:
The Human Genome Project was declared complete on April 14, 2003. Launched in 1990 after planning began in 1984, the international collaboration aimed to identify, map and sequence human genes and the base pairs composing human DNA. Its completed sequence covered about 92 percent of the genome.

Sequencing continued beyond the project's conclusion. Work in 2021 reduced the remaining uncertain regions, and a gapless sequence containing the twenty-two autosomes and the X chromosome was published in January 2022. The highly repetitive Y chromosome presented further assembly challenges; its full sequence followed in August 2023.
